units.source_text: 入学当初，我就注意柏木并不是没有缘由的。

en.t: It was not without reason that I noticed Kashiwagi from the very beginning of school.
His disability put me at ease.

units.source_text: 他的X型的腿从一开始就意味着对我所处的条件的共鸣。

en.t: From the start, his X-shaped legs signified a sympathy with the condition I was in.
